finding: Reforged item persistence can rotate a separately validated prior generation into backup and atomically restore that generation when the authoritative primary is missing, corrupt, or structurally invalid.
runtime_impact: active Reforged compatibility and crash-recovery infrastructure
character_save_impact: none; recovery remains scoped to the world item repository
world_state_impact: a corrupt primary cannot be accepted, an invalid primary cannot overwrite the validated backup, and successful recovery restores the primary file before returning state
assumptions: Native MajorMUD backup naming and journaling behavior remain unresolved
The Reforged JSON repository is authoritative only for Reforged runtime persistence
Automatic recovery is allowed only from a backup that independently passes the complete item and corpse validator
fallback: throw InvalidDataException while preserving both primary and backup files when neither generation validates
unknown_native_dependencies: native recovery ordering across character, economy, quest, and world saves
